name: Scholomance

entrance.note: Caer Darrow island, locked door. Horde Skeleton Key from The Key to Scholomance (5511) is required unless a rogue lockpicks. Coordinates from Questie dungeons.lua via dungeons.json. Do not route through Chillwind Camp (Alliance).

travel.how: Fly The Bulwark (Tirisfal/WPL border) and ride east around Darrowmere Lake onto Caer Darrow; Light's Hope is the pickup hub for Betina/Leonid, then ride west. Never send Horde to Chillwind Camp.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.notes: Optional exclusive city breadcrumb to The Bulwark (with 5094/5095). Not required for 5096. No dungeon-pack step.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.notes: Undercity copy of the exclusive breadcrumb. Skip if 5093 or 5095 already taken.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.notes: Thunder Bluff copy of the exclusive breadcrumb.

quests.name: Scarlet Diversions
quests.notes: Skeleton Key chain step 1. Outdoor WPL at The Bulwark. QDB has no pre (city breadcrumbs optional). Unlocks 5098. No dungeon-pack step; splice at The Bulwark on 40-60.

quests.name: All Along the Watchtowers
quests.notes: Skeleton Key chain step 2. Already present on horde-40-60 in Western Plaguelands. Unlocks 838. Alliance watchtower id is 5097 — do not use.

quests.name: Scholomance
quests.notes: Skeleton Key chain step 3: speak with Apothecary Dithers at The Bulwark. Req 55. Unlocks 964. Not in dungeons.json quest list (world key chain).

quests.name: Skeletal Fragments
quests.notes: Skeleton Key chain step 4: 15 Skeletal Fragments from Andorhal skeletons. Unlocks 5514.

quests.name: Mold Rhymes With...
quests.notes: Skeleton Key chain step 5: Imbued Skeletal Fragments plus 15 gold to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan. Unlocks 5802. Splice the turn-in on a Gadgetzan visit the 40-60 route already makes; do not add a special trip.

quests.name: Fire Plume Forged
quests.notes: Skeleton Key chain step 6: Skeleton Key Mold + 2 Thorium Bars at the lava lake on Fire Plume Ridge, Un'Goro. Horde id 5802 (Alliance 5801 — do not use). Turn in at Dithers, The Bulwark.

quests.name: Araj's Scarab
quests.notes: Skeleton Key chain step 7: kill Araj the Summoner in Andorhal (group elite). Horde 5804 (Alliance 5803). Unlocks 5511.

quests.name: The Key to Scholomance
quests.notes: Skeleton Key chain finale. Rewards the Skeleton Key that opens Scholomance. QDB start/end High Executor Derrington 10837 (not Dithers). Alliance finale is 5505 at Chillwind — do not use. Required before the run unless a rogue lockpicks.

quests.name: Plagued Hatchlings
quests.notes: 20 Plagued Hatchlings inside. Catalog balanced+speedrun. One clear; do not reset for more hatchlings (steps-v2 off-tip).

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.notes: Four deeds inside Scholomance. Horde Alexi Barov at The Bulwark (not Weldon at Chillwind). Catalog speedrun:false with why 'objectives outside the dungeon' — the deeds are inside; only the turn-in is at The Bulwark. Follow-up 5342 The Last Barov is outdoor (Weldon) and not in the dungeon pack.

quests.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
quests.notes: Kill Krastinov and burn Eva/Lucien remains inside. Eva stands on Caer Darrow next to the entrance (not Chillwind). Unlocks 5515. Catalog balanced+speedrun.

quests.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
quests.notes: Kill Jandice Barov, loot the bag. Accepted only after 5382 is turned in to Eva outside, so a single leveling run usually skips it. Unlocks 5384.

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
quests.notes: Blood of Innocents on the porch brazier, kill Kirtonos. Third Eva step; skip on a one-run level route. Leads to Stratholme Ras chain 5461 (not a Scholo step). Catalog speedrun:false.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
quests.notes: Needs Blackrock Spire Egg Collection (4735). Long out-of-zone chain; drop rather than detour to Flame Crest. Catalog balanced-only. Unlocks 5531.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
quests.notes: Deliver Frozen Eggs at Light's Hope. Low XP; only if 5522 was already turned in. Unlocks Dawn's Gambit 4771.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.notes: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room, kill Vectus. High XP but gated by the BRS egg chain. Catalog balanced+speedrun; still optional here because 5522 is a detour.

quests.name: The Ultimate Deception
quests.notes: endgame/attunement/alliance/skip: AQ war-effort briefing, outside 1-60 leveling.

quests.notes: endgame/attunement/alliance/skip: Lord Valthalak / Dungeon Set 2. Shared with several dungeons.

keys: Horde Skeleton Key chain (required to open the door; The Bulwark only — never Chillwind): optional exclusive breadcrumb 5093 Orgrimmar / 5094 Undercity / 5095 Thunder Bluff -> 5096 Scarlet Diversions (High Executor Derrington) -> 5098 All Along the Watchtowers -> 838 Scholomance (speak to Apothecary Dithers) -> 964 Skeletal Fragments (15 from Andorhal) -> 5514 Mold Rhymes With... (15g to Krinkle Goodsteel, Gadgetzan) -> 5802 Fire Plume Forged (mold + 2 Thorium Bars, Fire Plume Ridge) -> 5804 Araj's Scarab (Araj in Andorhal) -> 5511 The Key to Scholomance (Derrington, Skeleton Key).
Alliance key ids 5092 / 5097 / 5533 / 5801 / 5803 / 5505 are Chillwind and must not be used.
Rogues can lockpick the door; skill requirement is not in the catalog.
No quest named View of the Past exists in dungeons.json, steps-v2, QuestieDB, or web/public/data/quests.json. The in-repo key is the Skeleton Key chain above.

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 55-60; do not enter before 58 (runAt). Key (5511) or a lockpicker required.
warnings: Finish the Horde Skeleton Key chain at The Bulwark before offering the run, unless a rogue is lockpicking.
Do not send players to Chillwind Camp (Alliance hub for the parallel key chain).
Pickup hubs are The Bulwark (Derrington, Dithers, Alexi Barov) and Light's Hope Chapel (Betina, Leonid). Eva Sarkhoff is on Caer Darrow next to the portal.
Big trash rooms: control the Viewing Room and bone-mage rooms with line of sight (catalog tank tip).
Run once; do not reset for more Plagued Hatchlings (steps-v2).
5515 and 5384 need Eva turn-ins between bosses — skip on a one-run level route.
5522/5531/4771 need the Blackrock Spire egg chain (4735) — drop rather than detour to Flame Crest.
Kirtonos 5384 leads to the Stratholme Ras Frostwhisper chain (5461+); that chain lives in the Stratholme dossier.
classQuests: Warlock 7629 Imp Delivery (Dreadsteed, alchemy lab; pre 7625, req 60) — optional class/endgame, not in the dungeon pack.
Shaman 7667 Material Assistance then 8258 The Darkreaver Menace (Great Ossuary; req 60) — optional class epic.
Paladin Forever 97185 Justice and Retribution (Great Ossuary, Tirisfal giver) — optional Forever class, not in dungeons.json.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Bulwark cauldron shuttles and Writhing Haunt wildlife on horde-40-60 are the slow outdoor XP in the 55-58 band Scholo pays at 58. Do not drop 5098 (key chain).
Early EPL kill loops on horde-40-60 sit in the same band; Scholo hatchlings/deeds can replace them on speedrun.
Catalog dungeons-off names Winterspring with the Plaguelands; leftover Everlook kill quests on horde-40-60.

sourceConflicts: dungeons.json pickupHub says 'Chillwind/Bulwark'. Horde givers in QuestieDB are The Bulwark (Tirisfal 83.x, 69.x) and Light's Hope. Chillwind is Alliance; this dossier never uses it.

Prompt named a 'Skeleton Key / View of the Past chain'. No View of the Past quest is in QuestieDB, dungeons.json, steps-v2, or web/public/data/quests.json. Documented the Horde Skeleton Key chain 5096-5511 instead.
5511: QuestieDB start/end High Executor Derrington. Some Forever wiki pages list Apothecary Dithers. Used QDB.
5341 README why says 'objectives outside the dungeon'; the four deeds are inside Scholomance. Noted on the quest.

Key chain quests 5093-5511 are required to open the door but are not in the dungeons.json Scholomance quest list or steps-v2 (world WPL/Tanaris/Un'Goro). Included here with stepIds null so the planner can splice them at The Bulwark / Gadgetzan.
Classic Era XP in dungeons.json / QuestieDB; catalog notes Forever may halve dungeon-quest bonus XP (unofficial).
notes: Horde Scholomance, levels 55-60, runAt 58, placement inline (min+3 fits before 60). The Skeleton Key chain from High Executor Derrington and Apothecary Dithers at The Bulwark is required. Pickup hubs: The Bulwark and Light's Hope Chapel — never Chillwind. Core one-run quests: 5529, 5341, 5382. Eva follow-ups 5515/5384, the BRS egg chain into Dawn's Gambit, class epics, and all Bodley/DS2/AQ quests are optional. Dungeons-off: Western/Eastern Plaguelands, Winterspring and Silithus.
